About Poker Payout
Poker Payout is a free and open-source poker tournament management app. Version 1.0\n\nMIT Licensed - No ads, no tracking, no data collection.
Hand ranks
Best to worst
Royal Flush - A, K, Q, J, 10 suited; the unbeatable hand
Straight Flush - Five suited in sequence; highest card wins ties
Four of a Kind - Four matching ranks plus a kicker to break ties
Full House - Three of one rank with a pair; higher triplet wins
Flush - Any five suited cards; compare the highest then kickers
Straight - Five consecutive ranks; ace may play high or low
Three of a Kind - Three matching ranks with two kickers for ties
Two Pair - Two distinct pairs plus a kicker; top pair sets the rank
One Pair - One matching pair and three kickers; kickers decide ties
High Card - No combinations; rely on top card then remaining kickers
